name: Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Gecko Ascender GA-4
product_name: Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Gecko Ascender GA-4
description: A set of gloves and boots incorporating van der Waals force adhesion pads that allow the wearer to climb vertical surfaces and traverse ceilings like a gecko. Each pad contains millions of synthetic setae — microscopic hair-like structures that create molecular adhesion to any smooth surface. The GA-4 supports loads up to 150 kg (wearer plus equipment), and engagement/disengagement is controlled by a peeling motion that breaks the adhesion contact angle. The system works on glass, metal, concrete, and most polymers, but struggles with rough, porous, or wet surfaces where the setae cannot achieve full contact.

specifications.adhesion type: Van der Waals force synthetic setae
specifications.info: metal; concrete; polymer; porous; or wet surfaces; full hand/foot contact; 0.8 kg per pair (boots)

story_hooks: A break-in on the 40th floor of a sealed building with no roof access left investigators baffled until adhesion residue from GA-4 setae was found on the exterior glass — someone climbed 40 stories on the outside.
A modified GA-4 with enhanced setae density has been developed that works on wet surfaces — the manufacturer is unknown and the modification technique exceeds published material science capabilities.

physical_description.visual_profile: Form-fitting climbing gloves and boots with a sleek, biomimetic design. The gloves resemble high-performance athletic wear with subtle textured palm surfaces, while boots feature reinforced ankle support and aggressive sole geometry. Both pieces showcase a deliberate gecko-inspired aesthetic without appearing cartoonish — functional and elegant.
physical_description.dimensions: Standard adult hand/foot sizing; gloves ~25 cm length, boots ~30 cm length. Compact and integrated into normal apparel proportions.
physical_description.weight_description: Lightweight and pocketable as individual components; 0.6 kg per glove pair, 0.8 kg per boot pair. Worn during use, negligible fatigue even under full 150 kg load capacity.
physical_description.primary_material: High-tensile polymer composite framework with embedded synthetic setae arrays. Breathable mesh backing on gloves; reinforced neoprene-polymer hybrid on boots.
physical_description.finish: Matte charcoal base with iridescent micro-texture visible under angled light — the setae create a faint shimmering effect when light catches them. Slightly grippy tactile surface.
physical_description.color_scheme: Gunmetal gray primary with electric cyan accent stitching along seams and the Zheng-Dao logo. Sole edge trim in neon teal to highlight the high-adhesion contact zones.
physical_description.interface_elements: Minimal — no screens or haptics. Simple reinforced pull-tabs on glove cuffs and boot heels for donning/doffing. Faint pressure-sensitive micro-indicators on fingertips and heel pads (subtle LED dots that pulse when adhesion is optimal).
distinctive_features: Microscopic synthetic setae visible as fine texture under macro photography — appear as tiny hair-like striations across contact surfaces
Iridescent shift in the polymer coating catches light when wet or under neon illumination
Anatomically sculpted finger and toe articulation for maximum contact surface area
Reinforced knuckle and metatarsal protection in high-stress zones
Subtle hexagonal texture pattern etched into sole and palm — homage to gecko foot structure
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: ZHENG-DAO HEAVY INDUSTRIES logo (stylized dragon-gecko hybrid) embossed on outer ankle of boots and back of glove hands. Model number GA-4 printed in small white text. Regulatory compliance marks for GLMZ safety standards (Φ2,400 retail tier stamp visible on inner glove cuff).
physical_description.condition_typical: Clean, matte finish in showroom. In field use, they show subtle wear on contact surfaces and accumulate micro-scratches from repeated adhesion cycles. Dust and debris may cling to the setae, reducing efficiency — users typically brush or rinse them between climbs.
